verdict.rationale: The official ScrapingBee CLI lists "exports" among its documented functions, which suggests some first-party way to export scraped output. Nothing describes the export formats, portability, or any way to export job or schedule configurations for migration. missing for 10: documented export formats for scraped data, export of job/schedule configurations, explicit migration/anti-lock-in guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my scraped data and job configurations in a portable format to migrate to another provider without lock-in

citations.quote: Use the official ScrapingBee command-line interface for scraping, crawling, exports, schedules, and dedicated APIs.
